notes.title: Small bug fix patch now live!
notes.content:
Change log: 
Fixed the flickering in hub 2
Optimized and improved looks of some background objects
Fixed a bug with menu navigation
Fixed a bug with text displays for hub info

notes.title: V1.0.1 update!
notes.content:
Hey travelers!

We have launched our first update, fixing some lighting bugs on certain graphic configurations, improving the general lighting/textures in our levels, and added some fun flavor features. We have also added local high scores, to go along with the steam leaderboard.

Thanks so much for playing our game and Godspeed!
